gh pr comment 536 --body "CI is green on \`4bc64de\`: classify tier, protected paths (grant cross-check), and full gate shards 1/3, 2/3 and 3/3 all pass. The node 20 floor, docs guard and records tiers are skipped by the tier classifier, as expected for this change set.

One red shard on the way there, and it was the new test rather than the pass. \`resolveWriteRoots carries the working directory and the scratch roots\` asserted a macOS-shaped list of temp directory names; the suite builds its world under \`os.tmpdir()\`, which IS \`/tmp\` on a Linux runner, so \`resolveScratchRoots\` discards \`/tmp\` for containing the working directory (its own guard, and the right one) and the surviving root is \`/var/tmp\`. The assertion now states the property as agreement, \`resolveWriteRoots(cwd)\` is \`[cwd, ...resolveScratchRoots(cwd)]\`, which is the thing worth pinning: the write rule and the delete rule cannot disagree about where the agent's scratch is. Verified 10/10 locally under both temp layouts (\`TMPDIR=/tmp\` reproduces the runner). \`4bc64de\` touches no source file.

Still true and still needing a hand: **the merge is not armed**, because the gate daemon is down for this session." 2>&1 | tail -2
